subject.title: [Bug]: agents set-identity --workspace does not set the agent's stored workspace, but its success response implies it does

question: Should `openclaw agents set-identity --workspace` remain a locator-only flag with clearer output, or should the CLI gain a supported existing-agent workspace relocation path?
rationale: Both directions are plausible from current docs and code, but changing setter semantics or adding a new command affects a public operator CLI/config workflow.

options.title: Keep locator-only
options.body: Clarify the JSON/text response to call this a locator or identity source, and document that workspace relocation is not part of `set-identity`.

options.title: Add relocation CLI
options.body: Expose a dedicated `agents set-workspace` or `agents update` command using the existing Gateway/config mutation path, with focused docs and tests.

options.title: Make flag a setter
options.body: Change `set-identity --workspace` to update stored workspace, accepting the compatibility risk for users who currently use it only to read `IDENTITY.md`.

recommendation.title: Keep locator-only
recommendation.body: Clarify the JSON/text response to call this a locator or identity source, and document that workspace relocation is not part of `set-identity`.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the current agent CLI/Gateway surface and is the strongest available routing candidate for the public CLI contract choice.
